_note: Default config of TwoCompartmentWithNutrientFKPPSolver: every parameter, the optional ones at the class defaults (tests/test_config.py checks that). Volumes are NIfTI paths relative to this file; the tissue maps are the reference_solves/ maps (182x218x182, 1 mm). rho and white_matter_diffusivity are the means of fisher_kpp_jax/search_spaces/parameter_range.txt; the seed is the image center.
_placeholders: necrosis_rate, nutrient_threshold, nutrient_diffusivity and nutrient_consumption_rate are PLACEHOLDERS (the values of tests/test_solvers.py), not fitted values.
_treatment: The treatment parameters (resection_time to rt_alpha_beta_ratio below) are at their neutral values, so this is the untreated run: no resection (resection_time "inf", no resection_cavity), no chemotherapy (no session, chemo_kill_rate 0) and no radiotherapy (no fraction, no rt_dose, rt_alpha 0); chemo_decay_rate 9.24 /day (temozolomide's ~1.8 h plasma half-life, Baker et al. 1999, Clin Cancer Res 5:309) and rt_alpha_beta_ratio 10 Gy are inert without sessions and dose. The horizon is stopping_time; time_after_resection (the horizon relative to resection_time) is the other way to give it and at most one of the two may be set. A treated config of this model is this config plus the schedule block of fisher_kpp_jax/configs/FKPPSolver_stupp.json.
